reasoning_content: The issuer URL is `http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution`. The backend needs to reach the JWKS endpoint at that URL. But `auth.localhost:3000` — the backend running on the host needs to resolve/reach this. Port 3000 is traefik's HTTP. Let's test from host whether `auth.localhost:3000` resolves. `auth.localhost` likely resolves to 127.0.0.1. Let me curl the JWKS from host.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && echo \"=== resolve auth.localhost ===\"; getent hosts auth.localhost; echo \"=== JWKS via issuer url ===\"; curl -s -m 10 -w \"\\nHTTP %{http_code}\\n\" \"http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/certs\" | head -c 300; echo; echo \"=== discovery via issuer url ===\"; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w \"HTTP %{http_code}\\n\" \"http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/.well-known/openid-configuration\"", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Test JWKS reachability from host"}
